mapper.select: SELECT id, job_name, workspace_id, status, started_at, finished_at, detail FROM ( SELECT id, job_name, workspace_id, status, started_at, finished_at, detail, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY job_name ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC ) AS run_rank FROM job_run WHERE ( workspace_id IS NULL OR workspace_id IN ( SELECT org_workspace.id FROM JSON_TABLE( #{orgWorkspaceIdsJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS(id INT PATH '$') ) org_workspace ) ) AND status = #{status} ) ranked WHERE run_rank = 1 ORDER BY job_name
